name: Remove Fear
body:
You can free others from the shackles of terror.

Prerequisite(s): Aura of courage ability

Benefit: By touching a character who is affected by a fear effect, you give them the chance to make a second saving throw against the fear effect. Resolve this second chance exactly like the first saving throw against the fear effect. If the second roll fails, a paladin cannot use this feat on the same individual for 24 hours.
